errors.evidence: The pie slices are not arranged in descending order around the circle. The visible order is 体育 4%, 社会 20%, 榜样 19%, 政治 6%, 文化 14%, 经济 2%, 科学 21%, 环境保护 14% (clockwise from the top), not a monotonic descending sequence.
